links.comparator_used: Baseline LLM responses without the BODHI framework (no structured uncertainty decomposition or virtue-based stance rules)
links.outcome: Rate of appropriate clarifying questions / context-seeking in responses to HealthBench Hard vignettes
links.effect: 97.3% of GPT-4.1-mini responses and 73.5% of GPT-4o-mini responses included appropriate clarifying questions vs 7.8% and 0.0% at baseline; context-seeking rate Cohen's d = 16.38 and 19.54
links.quote: Crucially, 97.3% of GPT-4.1-mini responses and 73.5% of GPT-4o-mini responses included appropriate clarifying questions, compared to 7.8% and 0.0% at baseline, demonstrating the framework’s effectiveness in eliciting information-gathering behavior.

design_hint: prompt guardrails for uncertainty and humility (BODHI stance rules)
